deploy-bot: STARTED deploy to sbx (environment=sandbox) commit=6f4b2e7 tag=v1.4.2 author=@elaine

deploy-bot: steps: build -> image-push -> rollout(blue/green) -> smoke

elaine: Heads-up: this includes the lightweight KV migration patch. low-risk but will touch cache TTLs. change-window: none, sandbox only :clock1:

miguel: thanks — will watch metrics. @sre_oncall can you keep an eye on KV error counts?

ops-liz: noted. i'm patching the deploy-lock config to allow concurrent sandbox runs (sticky-lock=enabled -> will unlock on success).

deploy-bot: rollout: 20% -> 50% -> 100% complete. smoke checks at 20% passed.

tom: seeing a small spike in p95 for inference proxy (~110ms -> 210ms) on two nodes, correlates with cache warm-up. not widespread yet.

sre_oncall: copying metrics: KV miss ratio up ~3.2%, request retries bumped +2. will let you know if >5%

elaine: hold on final 100% until we confirm retries stabilize. prefer to pin current tag on canary to avoid flipping back and forth.

deploy-bot: PAUSED at 75% by request of @elaine — reason: p95 spike detected. current targets rolled: 3/4 groups.

miguel: agree with pin. suggestion: keep traffic at 75% and run an extended smoke: `curl -sS -H "x-test: sbx" https://sbx.api/redwood/generate --data '{"prompt":"smoke"}'` in a loop for 5m.

ops-liz: pin applied: active-deploy-tag pinned -> v1.4.2-staging. prevented subsequent auto-rollout.

deploy-bot: ACTION REQUIRED: rollback plan available. to rollback run: ```bash
git checkout main && git revert --no-commit 6f4b2e7 && git commit -m "revert: v1.4.2 sandbox" && ./scripts/deploy sbx --tag v1.4.1
```

elaine: let's avoid rollback unless >5% retries or errors. miguel can you run the extended smoke and share sample logs?

miguel: running now, sending snippets: `error: cache miss fallback; latency 180ms` (mostly warm-up). 1200 requests so far, retries holding at +1.6%

ops-liz: also verified there is a leftover sticky-lock entry from previous sandbox run — I cleared it manually to let the pin succeed. tagging ops note.

deploy-bot: MONITOR: continuing paused state, scheduled recheck in 3m. any change will trigger resume or rollback.

elaine: OK resume if retries <2% after 3m and p95 <150ms. otherwise we roll back.

sre_oncall: updated alert: paging threshold still 5% — will escalate if hit.

deploy-bot: RESUMED rollout to 100% at 1739123720 after conditions met by @miguel and @sre_oncall. final status: SUCCESS. smoke suite: 42/42 checks passed.

tom: verified latency returned to baseline ~95ms. good to close. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: FINISHED deploy to sbx tag=v1.4.2 commit=6f4b2e7 result=SUCCESS duration=6m24s

elaine: note for release log: include KV migration note and sticky-lock fix. follow-up: schedule a brief runbook update for sticky-lock clearing.

ops-liz: created ticket #OPS-452 to add automatic sticky-lock pruning for sandbox.

miguel: thanks all. will monitor for 1h and post if anything odd shows up.

deploy-bot: NOTE: next scheduled sandbox deploy window unlocked.
